label: Stay exceeded expectations
trigger: anticipatory service, a quiet upgrade or a personal touch
recovery_action: thank the guest and record the staff member

label: Location and access
trigger: walkable waterfront, ferry or old town access

label: Breakfast and food
trigger: breakfast quality, choice or service pace
recovery_action: invite the guest back and review the buffet line

label: Service recovery
trigger: a problem raised during the stay and fixed well
recovery_action: log the recovery and brief the shift

label: Room condition
trigger: wear, maintenance or an unfinished room
recovery_action: block the room and raise a work order

label: Noise and sleep
trigger: street, corridor or neighbouring room noise
recovery_action: offer a move and a sleep kit, note the room

label: Check-in and queue
trigger: a wait at arrival or a room released late
recovery_action: add a queue check at peak arrival

label: Billing and charges
trigger: an unexpected charge, deposit or rate mismatch
recovery_action: audit the folio and refund where due

label: Wifi and connectivity
trigger: dropped signal, slow link or a broken login
recovery_action: send the access point log to IT

label: Cleanliness
trigger: housekeeping missed a surface, linen or bathroom detail
recovery_action: reclean, inspect and coach the section

label: Group or family stay
trigger: a group, wedding or family booking with mixed needs
